request.task: A colleague says: 'Capital One held its PM hiring steady between the weeks of August 3 and August 17, four new openings each week, and most of those roles require prior product-management experience.' Check this using company filter 'Capital One' in pai-w-2026-08-03 and pai-w-2026-08-17. For each week report raw records and distinct openings under the published identity rule, and how many distinct openings require prior product-management experience under every option their stated qualifications allow, citing the qualification text. Assess each half of the claim, and say how much weight the week-to-week comparison can bear.
